posts.title: WELCOME TO RESKATE
posts.description: San Van is yours. Skate it your way.
posts.body:
The modding platform for skate.

Skate community maps, add mods to your Mods folder and ride with your crew.

In the pause menu:
- MULTIPLAYER: servers and sessions
- CUSTOM STUFF: world layers and parks
- MODS: your installed mods

Now go find a line.

posts.title: WHAT IS RESKATE?
posts.body:
A community modding platform for skate: custom maps, models, skins and more.

It's NOT a replacement for the live game, a way to get paid cosmetics, or a place for leaks.

Make cool stuff and have fun.
